mapper.select: SELECT scope_key, unfinished_count, add_paused, paused_since, high_watermark, low_watermark, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_scheduler_capacity_state WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT scope_key, unfinished_count, add_paused, paused_since, high_watermark, low_watermark, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_scheduler_capacity_state WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_scheduler_capacity_state SET unfinished_count = #{unfinishedCount}, add_paused = #{paused}::boolean, paused_since = CASE WHEN #{paused}::boolean THEN COALESCE(paused_since, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END, high_watermark = #{highWatermark}, low_watermark = #{lowWatermark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} RETURNING scope_key, unfinished_count, add_paused, paused_since, high_watermark, low_watermark, updated_at
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_scheduler_round SET round_number = round_number + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} RETURNING round_number
